title: Autopay Relief on Seller Settlement Down Payments
content:
**Rule.** On a spread failed-sale charge of a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order, the autopay relief lowers the down payment share for a seller whose active Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans plan is billed automatically.

| Billing of the seller's active Utility Line Protection Plans plan | Autopay relief |
|---|---|
| billed by automatic bank draft | lowers the down payment share by 10 percentage points |
| billed automatically to a card | lowers the down payment share by 5 percentage points |
| billed on the utility bill, or no active line plan | no autopay relief |

The down payment share after the relief is never below zero. The down payment is the open failed-sale balance times that share, rounded to the cent, and it is taken with the first settlement payment.

## Records read

The seller's Utility Line Protection Plans plan in status active and the billing channel shown on it: automatic bank draft, card, or the partner utility's bill.

## Illustrations (hypothetical sellers)

| Down payment share before the relief | Line plan billing | Down payment share after the relief |
|---|---|---|
| 40% | automatic bank draft | 30% |
| 15% | card | 10% |
| 5% | automatic bank draft | 0% (never below zero) |
| 25% | utility bill | 25% |
